messages:
maria-finance: FYI: Vector Labs (acct VL-992) still shows past due invoice INV-2026-017 for $24,900. Sent 3 dunning emails, no payment yet. Can we discuss short-term hold vs payment plan? @sam-cs @aj-legal

sam-cs: On it. I pinged their AM, @lee-am — they said cashflow crunch. Asked if we can split into 3 monthly payments.

lee-am: Confirming — client offered to pay $8,300 now, then two equal installments. Wants Dedicated pool uninterrupted. Requesting waiver of late fees if they hit the schedule.

anjali-collections: We can accept a payment plan but need a signed amendment and initial payment cleared. Recommend keeping service until 14 days past a missed payment. Late fee waiver needs exec sign-off.

aj-legal: I can draft the amendment. Need invoice details and the exact schedule. Who will take lead on signatures?

maria-finance: I'll prepare the schedule. Current invoice: INV-2026-017, issued 2026-01-15, due 2026-02-12, amount $24,900. Proposed schedule: $8,300 today, $8,300 on 2026-04-01, $8,300 on 2026-05-01. Remove $200 late fee if schedule met. Is that acceptable?

anjali-collections: OK if we get ACH/wire for initial and a card on file as backup. Add clause: suspend service if payment missed 7 days after a due date.

lee-am: Client agreed to wire the initial tomorrow morning. I'll send wiring instructions + signed PO. Will ask them to sign the amendment.

maria-finance: Pls cc finance@redwood-inference.com on the signed amendment. I'll flag INV-2026-017 as "payment plan pending" and hold escalation for 14 days after the first installment due date.

payment-bot: Notice: Second dunning email scheduled for 2026-03-02 if no payment recorded.

sam-cs: :thumbsup: If we get the initial today, can we waive the late fee now?

aj-legal: Exec sign-off required for fee waiver. @cfo please advise.

cfo: Provisional waiver OK pending cleared funds. Finance to confirm cleared wire before final waiver.

maria-finance: Understood. I'll draft the amendment and share the doc link: `https://console.redwood.com/invoices/INV-2026-017/amendment` — target to send today by 18:00 PST.

lee-am: Thanks all. I'll update once the wire is confirmed.
